data.body: [P2] Preserve warnings after incomplete integration runs. This condition includes failed runs, while timing uploads run with `always()` and the integration suite uses `bail: 1`. A failure before a previously slow file executes can produce partial results with no outliers, replacing the existing warning with “No test file is slower than usual.” The prior finding remains unresolved. Require successful integration-test completion before clearing the comment, or explicitly report incomplete results.
